objective.text: The investigation aimed to determine the conditions for which cool diffusion flames occur for propane, n-butane, and n-pentane.
objective.quote: Determine the conditions for which cool diffusion flames occur for propane, n-butane, and n-pentane; normal and inverse flames; and a broad range of Zst, Tad, and fluent flow rate.

fuel.text: The fuels tested include propane, n-butane, and n-pentane.
fuel.quote: Cool diffusion flames burning propane, n-butane, and n-pentane.

sample_geometry.text: The testing involved spherical porous burners.
sample_geometry.quote: Steady-state cool diffusion flames on spherical porous burners.

variables.text: Multiple fuels, a range of reactant dilutions, flow rates, and pressures were considered for normal and inverse convection directions.
variables.quote: Consider multiple fuels, a range of reactant dilutions, flow rates, and pressures for normal and inverse convection directions.

measurements.text: The flames were observed with a suite of cameras, radiometers, photomultiplier tubes, and thermocouples.
measurements.quote: Observe the flames with a broad suite of cameras, radiometers, photomultiplier tubes, and thermocouples.

earth_benefits.text: The measurements performed for this project will help to test and advance cool flame kinetics mechanisms, which should facilitate the development of more efficient internal combustion engines.
earth_benefits.quote: The measurements performed for this project will help to test and advance cool flame kinetics mechanisms. This should facilitate the development of more efficient internal combustion engines.
